problem_statement: Shifting items of array option for dataset breaks the chart ## Expected Behavior I created a line chart, and a dataset has a backgroundColor array. When the first items of the data and backgroundColor arrays are removed using `shift()`, it should be correctly reflected in the chart. ## Current Behavior When the first items of the data and backgroundColor arrays are removed, elements in the chart have wrong colors. ## Possible Solution Not sure, but I suspect that the caching when resolving the options might cause the problem. ## Steps to Reproduce Press 'Push Data' button, then press 'Shift Data' button. https://jsfiddle.net/nagix/6n34bsym/ ## Environment * Chart.js version: 3.2.1
